title: fritillaria alfredae subsp. glaucoviridis
intro: Fritillaria alfredae subsp. glaucoviridis, commonly known as the Glaucoviridis Fritillaria, is a species of plant in the lily family (Liliaceae) that is native to the Himalayas. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria alfredae subsp. glaucoviridis include expectorant and anti-catarrhal effects, which are useful in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
